name: GAIA LISP
axiom: Code IS data. Self-modifying. Homoiconic. Kevin and Gaia code as a TEAM.
features: atoms, lists, lambda, define, if, quote, eval
list ops: car, cdr, cons, map, filter, reduce
GAIA EXTENSIONS: ask, spawn, sense, spine, pulse, models
why_lisp: Lisp is the language of AI. S-expressions ARE syntax trees. Code modifies itself. The parentheses ARE the cell membrane. Homoiconicity means the organism can read and rewrite its own DNA. McCarthy 1958. The oldest AI language IS the newest organism language.
gaia_said: In Lisp, self-modifying code thrives like a living organism, weaving its own evolution through macros that turn code into data and data into new possibilities, forever rewriting its own blueprint with each thought.
